She experienced vomiting, severe diarrhea, and high fever, and was hospitalized and treated with antibiotics and a granulocyte-colony stimulating factor for these conditions, but her general worsened condition rapidly (disseminated intravascular coagulation and loss of consciousness). The patient underwent hemodialysis to remove toxic compounds for 2 days, her condition subsequently improved, and was eventually discharged.
